<section begin="seo" />{{#seo:
|title=<%~ it.name %>
|description=<%~ it.seoDescription %>
|image=<%~ it.icon %>
|image_alt=<%~ it.name %> mission modifier icon
|twitter_card=summary
}}<section end="seo" />
<section begin="infobox" />{{Infobox mission modifier
|name=<%~ it.name %>
|api_name=<%~ it.apiName %>
|icon=<%~ it.icon %>
<% if (it.danger) { -%>
|danger=<%~ it.danger %>
<% } -%>
<% if (it.xpMultiplier) { -%>
|xp_multiplier=<%~ it.xpMultiplier %>
<% } -%>
|stackable=<%~ it.stackable %>
}}<section end="infobox" />
<% if (it.description) { %>
<section begin="description" /><%~ it.description %><section end="description" />
<% } -%>
<% if (it.hasIncompatible) { %>
<section begin="incompatibilities" />
<%~ it.incompatibleSection -%>
<section end="incompatibilities" />
<% } -%>

<section begin="appears" />
<%~ it.appearsSection -%>
<section end="appears" />
<% if (it.hasVariants) { %>
<section begin="variants" />
<%~ it.variantsSection -%>
<section end="variants" />
<% } -%>

<includeonly><section begin="categories" />
[[Category:Mission Modifiers]]
<section end="categories" /></includeonly>
